title.en: Income Tax (Exemption of Foreign Income) (No. 10) Order 2013

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Income Tax (Exemption of Foreign Income) (No. 10) Order 2013.

2.—(1) Pan Pacific Hotels Group Limited is hereby granted exemption from tax on the dividends received in Singapore —
(a)on 22nd June 2012;
(b)on 26th December 2012;
(c)on 12th April 2013; and
(d)on or after 17th October 2013,
from HPL Properties (Malaysia) Sdn Bhd, a company located in Malaysia.
(2) The exemption under sub‑paragraph (1) is subject to the terms and conditions specified in the letter of approval dated 17th October 2013 addressed to Pan Pacific Hotels Group Limited.
